user.title: Set up ezAIoT
user.description: ezAIoT scans local Home Assistant registries for supported Rti-Tek thermostatic valves. It does not control devices or change Zigbee configuration.

init.title: ezAIoT support
init.description: Add `zha: custom_quirks_path: /config/zha_quirks` to configuration.yaml, restart Home Assistant, then use the ezAIoT sidebar to install the approved Quirk Release. Reconfigure or re-pair the device when the guidance asks you to. Use Home Assistant's Download diagnostics action before requesting support.
